MEASURED CW 1.2 FACTORY WALL: dScMgBSC_c_classInit is allocation plus a fully folded scene construction sequence. The compiler rejects class, global and placement operator-new declarations and supplies no placement-new builtin, so semantic placement construction cannot reproduce the body. The one literal classInit bridge is retained; its allocation size, base construction, vptr transitions, Particle::SysTracker member, typed shared-state construction and card-position array construction all remain explicit and byte-exact.

FOCUSED VERIFY LIMITATION: tools/tubuild.py verify reports 19/20 because objisolate rejects the classInit's R_ARM_ABS32 relocation with addend zero against _ZTV10dScMgBSC_c emitted by the same object. The extracted classInit bytes match individually and all 20 text sections occur in cartridge order; the production linker and full ROM build are the authority for that same-object vtable relocation.

COINED NAMES, the one thing not provable: the state handlers' ROM symbols are address-only (func_ov006_02124a04..), so no recovered spelling exists to confirm or contradict StateDone/StateReturnCards/StateWaitTable/StateTableReaction/StateJudgeCards/StateRevealCards/StateWaitMove/StateMoveCards/StateChooseCard/StateWaitDeal/StateDealCards. The coinage is disclosed here, in include/dScMgBSC_c.h's state-machine comment, and in symbols/actor_renames.tsv's why column; the three event names (OnYoshiTryEat/OnTurnIntoEgg/OnGroundPounded) are legacy recovered names that stand uncontradicted. Table entries 7/8 (StateTableReaction) have no mState writer anywhere in the recovered code -- kept byte-exact, see the source comment.

D3 declarations: Math_Function_0203b14c, func_ov006_020c1718, func_ov006_020c1a88, func_ov006_020c19d0 and func_ov006_020c0d68 are declared at the definition's own signatures where this TU alone owns the declaration (the first four); func_ov006_020c0d68 and func_ov006_020c0c80 keep decl_common.h's void* spellings because redeclaring a C-linkage symbol with different parameter types is an illegal overloading.
